item.title: Namecheap Gave My Account to an Unverified Third Party Just Because They Asked
item.description:
📝 I’ve been a NameCheap customer for 13 years. They figured out the domain name was parked at NameCheap, so they initiated a password reset using the domain name. The incoming club leader was persistent though, and called NameCheap support.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49028037
